title: Block a stable protocol suite while any critical or high threat is open
summary: Pre-charter record of the stable release rule in the threat register: the suite stays a candidate until each critical or high threat is mitigated by a numbered requirement or accepted with a reviewer, date, and rationale. Open high threats at the time of recording: TM-004, TM-006, TM-008, TM-014, TM-018.
note: Recorded retroactively from commit b949407a0. The rule predates this charter and was never ratified by a security response team, so it does not count as a completed charter process. TM-004 and TM-014 come from the 2026-07 security audit.
